description.text: A broad, empty railway platform stretches into the distance under flat, even daylight. The platform surface runs beside the tracks, and a hanging sign is fixed above the exit. No passengers or staff are present; the space is still, with the sign and the open platform forming the only points of attention.
The empty platform and the hanging exit sign remain still under flat daylight.
A quiet station ambience lingers around the empty platform.

At the platform, a train begins to pull away. Its carriages slide steadily out of the frame along the rails, and the platform is left vacant. The same flat daylight continues over the now-empty station as the last carriage clears the view.
The train pulls away from the platform, its carriages sliding out of frame and leaving the platform vacant.
The sound of the departing train carries across the station.

soundscape: Natural station ambience and the low mechanical sound of the departing train.

constraints.text: The target contains no music, including copied background music.
